_comment: The single declaration of what Lazyfox's installer ships and which installer
binaries exist. It lives inside the payload package because that is the one
place Go can //go:embed it, and every build script reads the very same file.
It exists to kill a whole bug class: the chrome file list used to be copied
into four places (this package's registry, the build's staging step, the dev
helpers' staleness hash, and the installer's own test), and a file added to
three of them shipped a half-installed chrome layer that no test noticed.
One declaration, read by all of them, cannot drift.
Destination paths (which subdirectory a file lands in) stay in the Go
registry — they are install behavior, not build inputs. Only the names and
the target list are shared here.
_userJS: Managed prefs, MERGED into the profile's user.js rather than copied over it, so it is staged as a chrome file but installed through its own artifact kind.
_targets: Every shipping installer target, with the file name each one is committed under. devOut embeds the UNSIGNED add-on (nightly channel, for `npm run dev-install`); releaseOut embeds the AMO-signed one (stable channel). The native GUI window can only be compiled on its own platform — every other target gets the cross-compiled terminal installer (see buildInstaller).
